title: Praline Crunch Collection (4 bars)
description:
Fresh nuts are carefully roasted with sugar in a copper pot, a French technique that perfectly roasts and coats each nut in caramel. Once cooled, the nuts are ground into a smooth paste, and chocolate is folded in. What comes out is not sweet the way a candied nut is sweet. The caramel goes dark and toasty, the roast comes forward instead of hiding behind sugar, and the chocolate holds the whole thing together.
All four have a 65% bittersweet chocolate shell, with a little organic crisped brown rice folded in for texture (that is the crunch in the name). 6.4 oz each, made by hand in San Francisco.
Peanut.
The least fancy nut in the box and usually the one that surprises people the most. Deep roasted, and the praliné turns them into something that tastes very little like the peanut butter cup you are imagining.
Hazelnut.
 Everyone has eaten hazelnut and chocolate out of a jar. This is our elevated approach to that spread, and it is the bar I hand people when they tell me they have no idea what praliné is.
Pecan.
 The perfect flavor profile for Fall. Applying the French praline technique to pecans creates something warm and inviting.
Almond.
 Interestingly, this is the only one of the four with bittersweet chocolate mixed into the praline itself, rather than dark milk chocolate. Against the warm flavor of the almonds it makes a real difference, and the result is something special.
All four have a 65% bittersweet chocolate shell, with a little organic crisped brown rice folded in for texture (that is the crunch in the name). 6.4 oz each, made by hand here in San Francisco.
Set of Four Bars Total Net Weight: 25.6 oz. (720 g)

title: Dubai Done Better (3 Bars)
description:
Who has not seen the now viral Dubai Bar on social media – it has taken the chocolate world by storm. When I finally got one to try, I was both really impressed by the originality of the bar and disappointed by how super sugary sweet it was.
In that great Charles Chocolates tradition, we set out to make what we think is the ultimate expression of that really cool idea.
Instead of sweet milk chocolate, we use a rich, bittersweet chocolate blend that truly compliments the pistachio and crisp shredded kataifi filling. And while we are talking about the filling, every version of the Dubai Bar that I have tried uses a pre-made, very sweet pistachio cream. Given that we were both trying to reduce the sweetness and also stick to our “we make everything from scratch” ethos, our pistachio cream is made fresh here in our kitchens from premium fresh pistachio nuts.
Finally, and because we love to play in the kitchen, we have created two additional flavors that are every bit as good as the original. Try all three – you won’t be disappointed!

title: Chocolate Covered Lemon and Orange Peels Variety Pack
description:
Our best selling Chocolate Covered Orange and Lemon Peels now come in a variety pack so you don't have to pick just one peel. Two each of our orange and lemon peels are the perfect way to share our delicious handcrafted treats...or just keep an emergency backup stash for yourself!
Valencia oranges make the most distinctive and (we think) best candied peel. After a multi-day process that brings out the best of the orange, without the strong bitter taste that some candied peel can have, we dry and then coat each piece in bittersweet chocolate.
Lemon peel tends to be much harder to do well—the inherent bitterness of the peel and pith are significantly harder to tame. Our Chocolate Covered Lemon Peel keeps just a touch of that bitterness balanced with the lemony flavor that we all love. The bittersweet chocolate coating just seals the deal.
